summary_en: This study tests TL118 in solid tumors that have an NTRK gene fusion. TL118 is taken by mouth as a capsule, 252 mg twice daily, in 28-day cycles. The main goal is to evaluate how well TL118 works (efficacy); the specific outcome measure is not stated, and this is a Phase 2 study.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa TL118 en tumores sólidos que tienen una fusión del gen NTRK. TL118 se toma por vía oral en cápsulas, 252 mg dos veces al día, en ciclos de 28 días. El objetivo principal es evaluar qué tan bien funciona TL118 (eficacia); la medida específica de resultado no se indica, y es un estudio de Fase 2.
who_for: Locally advanced or metastatic solid tumor with an NTRK1, NTRK2 or NTRK3 gene fusion, without a second cancer driver.
Disease progressed during or after prior treatment, or not suitable for standard therapy in the investigator's opinion.
ECOG score of 0, 1 or 2, and life expectancy over 3 months.
not_for: Systemic anti-tumor therapy within 3 weeks before enrollment, or immunotherapy within 4 weeks.
Prior TRK inhibitor treatment, except stopped for less than 28 days due to intolerable toxicity.
Other primary malignant tumors within 3 years, with listed exceptions.
Uncontrolled active infection, or unresolved toxicity above Grade 1 from prior therapy.
